title: SilverSpoon-KD: A General-Purpose Toolkit for Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22842v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers deep learning representations from a teacher model to a student model, typically reducing model size or inference cost. However, knowledge distillation tooling has not kept pace with the breadth of research methods: existing toolkits typically support only a limited subset of techniques and use cases. We present SilverSpoon-KD, an open-source PyTorch toolkit that unifies different distillation paradigms and architectural relationships across workloads and applications behind a single API. Moreover, SilverSpoon-KD offers the first general-purpose blockwise knowledge distillation implementation with unique scalability features. We validate its versatility across vision, masked language model, and causal language models on tasks spanning homogeneous, heterogeneous, and quantization distillation across paradigms. We also evaluate SilverSpoon-KD by comparing its performance, including throughput and GPU memory

translated_title: SilverSpoon-KD：一个通用知识蒸馏工具包
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏将深度学习表示从教师模型迁移到学生模型，通常用于减小模型规模或降低推理成本。然而，知识蒸馏工具的发展未能跟上研究方法的广度：现有工具包通常仅支持有限的技术子集和使用场景。我们提出了SilverSpoon-KD，一个开源的PyTorch工具包，它通过单一API统一了不同工作负载和应用中的多种蒸馏范式与架构关系。此外，SilverSpoon-KD提供了首个通用的逐块知识蒸馏实现，具备独特的可扩展性特性。我们在视觉、掩码语言模型和因果语言模型上验证了其通用性，涵盖同构蒸馏、异构蒸馏和量化蒸馏等多种范式。我们还通过比较其性能（包括吞吐量和GPU内存）对SilverSpoon-KD进行了评估。
tldr: SilverSpoon-KD是一个开源PyTorch知识蒸馏工具包，通过单一API统一了多种蒸馏范式与架构关系，并首创了通用的逐块知识蒸馏实现，在视觉和语言模型等任务上验证了其通用性与高性能。
en_tdlr: SilverSpoon-KD is an open-source PyTorch toolkit that unifies diverse knowledge distillation paradigms and architectural relationships behind a single API, offering the first general-purpose blockwise distillation implementation validated across vision and language model tasks.
